image_description: A colorful minibus (likely a Ford Transit based model) with a red roof, lime green upper body, and maroon lower body. It features a prominent front grille, large windshield, side windows, and visible wheels. The vehicle is parked on a paved surface with some background foliage.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof van/minibus silhouette, distinct from full-size buses and standard cars.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible, along with side windows for the driver and passenger area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is consistent with a minibus. A sliding door track/handle is visible on the side, indicating the entrance location.
The panel gap and handle on the side indicate a sliding door mechanism typical of this vehicle class.
The short hood and grille placement confirm a front-engine layout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the frame/occluded by the angle of view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a multi-colored livery (red/green/maroon) which fits the 'company livery' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible front wheel matches the size and style of a commercial van/minibus.
The overall scale and window configuration are consistent with a 4-10 passenger capacity vehicle.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the front license plate ('...ON...') and the destination sign in the windshield are illegible and structurally nonsensical, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than clear characters.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness and lack of sharp mechanical definition in the side mirror assembly and door handles compared to the rest of the bodywork.
